title: Semantic infrastructure as practice: priority terms and projected uptake
description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records claim Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure (#767), Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output (#766), Autonomous Semantic Warfare (#100) and machine-mediated resistance literature (#1064). Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's practice (#214) and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary (#262) to the Ghost Meaning atlas's projected citations (#520). Dodecad safeguards (#90), Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member (#1440) and MPAI signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch follow; the valuation memo (#1608) later holds that more semantic infrastructure will not fix the problem. Four claims are unrelated.
